name: high-voltage
description: Mains, high-voltage or safety-isolated boards. The pipeline enforces the stated creepage/clearance rules and DRC, but safety isolation and regulatory compliance require qualified human sign-off.
notes: Creepage and clearance must be derived from the applicable standard, pollution degree, altitude and coating.
Autorouting high-voltage nets is prohibited unless the router is constrained by verified clearance rules; review every clearance.
The pipeline does not certify safety, isolation or regulatory compliance.
